task: ACCT-F289 (completes FAIL-I1): ACCT-F267 taught accounting/from-load.ts to REFUSE a zero-rate load (throw load_has_no_rate) rather than mint a permanently $0 invoice. The refusal is correct; its blast radius was never scoped. (1) dispatch/book-load.service.ts awaits buildInvoiceFromLoad INSIDE the booking transaction on the booking client, so the throw ROLLED THE WHOLE BOOKING BACK - a rate-late load (bookLoadRateTotalCents([]) === 0, the quicksave/rate-TBD path) could not be booked at all. Verified live on prod br-fancy-credit-akjnd07a: broker_advance_applied_cents EXISTS (so the throwing branch is the one that runs) and INVOICE_PROFORMA_PIPELINE_ENABLED is enabled=true on all three entities, expires_at NULL. (2) accounting/invoices.routes.ts translated only load_not_found, so the user's own create-invoice-from-load action answered with an opaque 500. Fix applies the policy the sibling branch already states ten lines below - an accounting projection must never block dispatch from booking a real load - by making the skip COUNTABLE (same append-only audit row, same client) and mapping the route to 422. Catch is NARROW: everything that is not load_has_no_rate still propagates. NO posting-math change, NO migration, additive only.
